latency.index_record_minimum: 3 phases, each selected stack ACK, then identity-visible pulse

reset: Outstanding per-port identities retained/quarantined on reset; no admission or retirement until explicit backend drain and matching reconciliation.

Actual stage launch context and restore handshake connected by C8

completion_matching: Native backend supplies the actual completed queue entry address/tag; match exactly one enrolled seat. No FIFO-order assumption across bank scheduler reordering.

context_binding.parameter: C8_CONTEXT=0 by default, selected only with C8_PUBLICATION=1
context_binding.reset_debt: actual journals and queued/active descriptor state quarantine; reset/empty is not retirement
context_binding.core_entry: c8_entry14 routed through the actual retained host_entry to tile.entry; no program-counter stand-in
context_binding.restore: c8_context_restored must real caller VM/context restore; not tied ready

context_binding.retirement: actual retained core done plus native journal quiet and no write fault/quarantine

two_position_native_reuse.selected_control_fix: C8_PUBLICATION selection clear wins over the later collector npresent assignment; legacy default unchanged

two_position_native_reuse.reuse_contract: Actual own nine backend ACKs and fetch job_ready plus empty native journal before selection/table reuse; retain first row in actual HBM without reset
two_position_native_reuse.functional_gate: tb_dsrom_c8_two_positions; two identities same user; second reads first native row; not whole L20 arithmetic or wavefront interval

two_position_native_reuse.parent_retirement: Actual local CKV fetch readiness, no output/launch pulse, ID read/tail finished, no merger release, own writer/encoder idle required in c8_write_quiet; no inference of remote all-copies retirement
